column1: # A7c receipt-B notes (human-written, after the run; values copied from summary.json of run 20261006T113938Z-97ee27584cda-silicon)

column2: Secure Boot was OFF for this run (Drake's explicit decision, cc-0021), a deviation from R15 spec clarification C2 (Secure Boot and integrity lockdown stay on); lockdown read "[none] integrity confidentiality". The SPBM reader loaded with "module verification failed: signature and/or required key missing - tainting kernel", so the kernel was tainted for the whole run.

Other users' boot-time services were resident and not stopped: atlas dedicated-image_server.py (pid 3632, 18408 MiB GPU memory, 0 percent GPU utilisation when sampled), a caption server, a MAX Llama-3.2-1B serve, atlas-max-coder and atlas-max-qwen in auto-restart. Section 9 asks for a machine with nothing heavy. Process lists before and after are in processes-before.txt and processes-after.txt of the raw run. The result is reported as measured; no trial was dropped or rerun.

Spec section 11 asks that every metric where the resident path is worse than SEQ be listed with its justification. This receipt does not itemize those regressions: they are in the embedded summary.json (comparisons, L1 and L2 percentiles) and no gate failed. The itemized and justified list of attempt 2 (evidence/R15/receipt-notes.tsv in the CAND-1 receipt 065c6884...) is not claimed to carry over to this run.

G10 (amendment A1, spec section 21) counts synchronization events with exactly one GPU claim in flight; a multi-claim-in-flight phase is deferred. Host spin (not gated): RES-1 38.1 vs SEQ 122.5 empty polls per GPU result in this run.

Package energy comes from the SPBM reader at /sys/class/hwmon/hwmon3 (module sha256 2d37f51a90a74a7af2aae5e0f7171df357cb194d11cef614d37d6b43aa0dd8b0, srcversion D7345BB5C0CCFCB7B177335). The energy-preflight passed before the run; that a restart resets the counter every time is UNVERIFIED. The reduce.log line "17 of 16 gates pass" is a counting artifact of the script (it also counts the summary line "all gates: PASS"); the 16 gates G1-G16 are all PASS in summary.json.
